main.description: Compose and publish an atproto-compatible social post (app.bsky.feed.post shape) about a kabuto company or supply-chain intel finding, written into the kotoba Datom log via kotoba-server com.etzhayyim.apps.kotoba.atproto.repo.write. The post body is generated from PUBLIC facts only and is aggregate-first + non-adjudicating (kabuto G3/G4). OUTWARD-GATED (G11): live publication requires KABUTO_LIVE_POST operator gate; default is dry-run. Charter Rider §2(a)-(h) scan runs on every post body before write.

subjectId.description: :company/id or :supply.edge/id or kabuto report id the post is about

text.description: post body (atproto grapheme limit); aggregate-first, public facts only

facets.description: optional atproto richtext facets (links to did.json / report CID)

live.description: false = dry-run (operator gate KABUTO_LIVE_POST not set)

facet.description: An atproto richtext facet — a byte range annotated with one or more features (link / mention / tag).

features.description: facet features applied to this byte range

facetFeature.description: A single facet feature (e.g. a link to a did.json / report CID).
